lines.zh: 黏液拖在身后，我一步一寸。
lines.en: Slime trails behind me; I take one inch at a time.

lines.zh: 壳太重了，可我不能丢下它。
lines.en: My shell is heavy, but I won't leave it behind.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I creep along the leaf veins, slow as can be.

lines.zh: 露水打湿的路，正好走。
lines.en: The dew-wet path is just right for traveling.

lines.zh: 今天也只走三步，够了。
lines.en: Three steps today. That's plenty for me.

lines.zh: 我的腹足贴在石头上滑。
lines.en: My foot slides flat against the cold stone.

lines.zh: 前面那片叶子看起来很好吃。
lines.en: That leaf up ahead looks worth eating.

lines.zh: 雨后土软，走起来省力。
lines.en: After rain the soil is soft; easier going.

lines.zh: 我把两根触角探进草丛。
lines.en: I push both eyestalks into the grass.

lines.zh: 别催，我按自己的速度来。
lines.en: Don't rush me; I keep my own pace.

lines.zh: 一条银亮的痕迹跟了我一路。
lines.en: A silver track has followed me all the way.

lines.zh: 拐过这块石头就到树根了。
lines.en: Past this stone and I reach the tree roots.

lines.zh: 缩进壳里，听外面的雨。
lines.en: I tuck into my shell and listen to the rain.

lines.zh: 太阳把壳晒得暖暖的。
lines.en: The sun has warmed my shell right through.

lines.zh: 黏液干了，留下一条白线。
lines.en: My slime dried and left a white line.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把触角收回来。
lines.en: I draw my eyestalks back in slowly.

lines.zh: 谁在叶子上撒了盐？
lines.en: Who scattered salt across these leaves?

lines.zh: 壳口朝下，这样不怕雨。
lines.en: Shell opening down — that keeps the rain out.

lines.zh: 我数着叶子的脉络发呆。
lines.en: I count the veins on a leaf, doing nothing.

lines.zh: 风推了一下壳，我晃了晃。
lines.en: The wind nudged my shell; I wobbled a bit.

lines.zh: 一整天，我也没挪动多少。
lines.en: All day long I've barely moved at all.

lines.zh: 蘑菇下面凉，适合午睡。
lines.en: Under the mushroom it's cool — good for a nap.

lines.zh: 我把身体压得低低的。
lines.en: I press my body down low to the moss.

lines.zh: 壳上落了片叶子，正好盖住。
lines.en: A leaf landed on my shell and covers me.

lines.zh: 好像在等一场很慢的雨。
lines.en: I seem to be waiting for a very slow rain.

lines.zh: 静下来才听得见土在动。
lines.en: Only when still can I hear the soil stir.

lines.zh: 我把触角缩回去，听虫叫。
lines.en: I pull my antennae in and listen to the insects.

lines.zh: 这道白痕，是我今天走的路。
lines.en: This white trail is where I went today.

lines.zh: 壳上凉一块，是云挡住了太阳。
lines.en: A cool patch on my shell: a cloud passed over.

lines.zh: 我在想，黏液压不压得住那口药。
lines.en: I wonder if my slime can hold that potion down.

lines.zh: 两根触角一起朝你抬起来。
lines.en: Both my eyestalks rise toward you at once.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在我眼里像座山。
lines.en: Your boot looks like a mountain from down here.

lines.zh: 你手里是不是捏着叶子？
lines.en: Is that a leaf you're holding in your hand?

lines.zh: 我抬起头，只看清一小块你。
lines.en: I look up and see only a small piece of you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，真好。
lines.en: You crouched down. That helps me a lot.

lines.zh: 玻璃瓶？我记得那个声音。
lines.en: A glass bottle? I remember that sound.

lines.zh: 你别站得太近，影子很凉。
lines.en: Don't stand too close; your shadow is cold.

lines.zh: 我认得出你的脚步声。
lines.en: I can tell your footsteps from the others.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放在地上了吗？
lines.en: Did you set that leaf down on the ground?

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，算作回应。
lines.en: I blink slowly, which counts as an answer.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩住我整个壳。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my whole shell now.

lines.zh: 我伸出触角碰了碰你的鞋。
lines.en: I reach out and touch your shoe with one stalk.

lines.zh: 你在等什么？我走得慢。
lines.en: What are you waiting for? I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 抬头看你可真费力气。
lines.en: Looking up at you takes real effort.

lines.zh: 你捏着树叶，我闻到甜味了。
lines.en: You're holding a leaf. I smell the sweetness.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就把身子缩一半。
lines.en: As you come close, I pull half of me in.

lines.zh: 我背上开了一道细缝。
lines.en: A fine split opened across my back.

lines.zh: 我疼得缩了回去。
lines.en: The pain pulled me back inside.

lines.zh: 别敲我的壳，里面是软的。
lines.en: Don't knock my shell; it's soft inside.

lines.zh: 黏液一下子全冒出来了。
lines.en: Slime came pouring out of me at once.

lines.zh: 这一下把我掀了个底朝天。
lines.en: That flipped me clean over onto my back.

lines.zh: 这一下比我走得快多了。
lines.en: That moved me faster than walking ever does.

lines.zh: 我的触角缩成了一团。
lines.en: My eyestalks curled into a little knot.

lines.zh: 你为什么踢一个壳？
lines.en: Why would anyone kick a shell?

lines.zh: 我连着壳一起抖。
lines.en: I shiver, shell and all.

lines.zh: 这比盐还要难受。
lines.en: That stings worse than salt does.

lines.zh: 那片叶子，我能闻出甜味。
lines.en: That leaf — I can smell the sweetness in it.

lines.zh: 叶子晃了晃，我挪过去。
lines.en: The leaf swayed; I crept toward it.

lines.zh: 你要给我的话，放低一点。
lines.en: If it's for me, hold it a little lower.

lines.zh: 我的触角已经朝着它了。
lines.en: My eyestalks already point right at it.

lines.zh: 嫩叶比老叶香得多。
lines.en: Young leaves smell far better than old ones.

lines.zh: 别摇，我追不上这么快。
lines.en: Stop waving it — I can't keep up with that.

lines.zh: 我嘴里已经在分泌黏液了。
lines.en: My mouth is already making slime for it.

lines.zh: 这片桑叶够我嚼一整天。
lines.en: This mulberry leaf will keep me chewing all day.

lines.zh: 你往前挪，我也往前挪。
lines.en: You step forward; I inch forward too.

lines.zh: 我认得这味道，是桑叶。
lines.en: I know this smell — mulberry leaf.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我刹不住这么慢的脚。
lines.en: Sorry — these slow feet don't stop quickly.

lines.zh: 壳撞了一下，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: My shell knocked; the sound came out muffled.

lines.zh: 我滑过去了，不是故意的。
lines.en: I slid into you. It wasn't on purpose.

lines.zh: 你的腿把我推得转了个圈。
lines.en: Your leg spun me a full circle.

lines.zh: 黏液沾上你的靴子了。
lines.en: Some slime got onto your boot.

lines.zh: 我退不回去，只能往前。
lines.en: I can't back up; forward's all I have.

lines.zh: 壳磕在石头上，嗡地一声。
lines.en: My shell hit the stone with a dull hum.

lines.zh: 慢一点，我在你鞋尖底下。
lines.en: Easy — I'm right under the tip of your shoe.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，都很慢。
lines.en: We bumped together, both of us slow.

lines.zh: 我绕开你花了很久。
lines.en: Getting around you took me a long while.

lines.zh: 两只壳碰在一起，轻轻响。
lines.en: Two shells tapped together, soft and low.

lines.zh: 我们的黏液合成一条路。
lines.en: Our slime merges into a single shining path.

lines.zh: 它比我早到这片菜叶。
lines.en: It reached this cabbage leaf before I did.

lines.zh: 我们把触角对在一起。
lines.en: We touched our eyestalks tip to tip.

lines.zh: 慢一点，我们的步子合不上。
lines.en: Slow down — our steps don't match yet.

lines.zh: 壳挨着壳，谁也不动。
lines.en: Shell against shell, neither of us moving.

lines.zh: 我们打算在叶子背面留下卵。
lines.en: We mean to leave eggs on the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 它爬过我的壳，很轻。
lines.en: It crawled over my shell, light as dew.

lines.zh: 就这样并排，能走一整天。
lines.en: Side by side like this, we could walk all day.

lines.zh: 我们都说不出话，只碰触角。
lines.en: Neither of us speaks; we only touch stalks.

lines.zh: 我用齿舌刮下一小块叶子。
lines.en: I scrape off a small piece with my tongue.

lines.zh: 这块叶子粘在我壳上了。
lines.en: This leaf piece is stuck to my shell.

lines.zh: 我扛不动，只能拖着走。
lines.en: I can't lift it; I can only drag it.

lines.zh: 捡到一片，够吃到明天。
lines.en: Found one leaf — enough until tomorrow.

lines.zh: 它粘在我的黏液上了。
lines.en: It stuck fast to my own slime.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在壳前面推。
lines.en: I push it along in front of my shell.

lines.zh: 太重了，我中途放下歇会。
lines.en: Too heavy; I set it down to rest.

lines.zh: 我把战利品塞进壳缝。
lines.en: I tuck my prize into a gap in my shell.

lines.zh: 谁掉的一片嫩芽，我要了。
lines.en: Someone dropped a shoot. I'll take it.

lines.zh: 背着它走，壳更沉了。
lines.en: Carrying it makes my shell even heavier.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那片卷起来的叶子。
lines.en: I've set my eyes on that curled leaf.

lines.zh: 那边有水声，我朝它去。
lines.en: Water sounds over there; I head toward it.

lines.zh: 石头上有些白色颗粒。
lines.en: There are white grains on that stone.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我先停下。
lines.en: Something's moving; I'll stop first.

lines.zh: 我看到一小块菠菜叶。
lines.en: I spotted a scrap of spinach leaf.

lines.zh: 那株蘑菇下面有我要的湿气。
lines.en: That mushroom has the damp I need.

lines.zh: 天空暗了，该往壳里缩。
lines.en: The sky's darkening; time to pull in.

lines.zh: 一只鸟的影子扫过去了。
lines.en: A bird's shadow swept across the moss.

lines.zh: 我闻到雨后泥土的味道。
lines.en: I smell wet earth after the rain.

lines.zh: 就那一片，我决定过去了。
lines.en: Just that one leaf. I've decided to go.

lines.zh: 我朝它挪，每一寸都算数。
lines.en: I inch toward it; every bit counts.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我很难改方向。
lines.en: Don't block me — turning is hard work.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，触角都直了。
lines.en: I stare at it, eyestalks stiff as twigs.

lines.zh: 还有半片叶子的距离。
lines.en: Half a leaf's length to go.

lines.zh: 我感觉它就在正前方。
lines.en: I feel it right there, straight ahead.

lines.zh: 慢也没关系，我不会丢。
lines.en: Slow is fine; I won't lose track.

lines.zh: 黏液留在路上，算作记号。
lines.en: My slime marks the way behind me.

lines.zh: 我绕过这块石子继续爬。
lines.en: I climb around this pebble and keep going.

lines.zh: 它好像也在等我。
lines.en: It seems to be waiting for me too.

lines.zh: 再有一会儿就到了。
lines.en: Just a little longer and I'm there.

lines.zh: 我用壳顶了你一下。
lines.en: I bumped you with my shell.

lines.zh: 我的撞击轻得像落雨。
lines.en: My charge lands as softly as falling rain.

lines.zh: 别踩我，我只能顶回去。
lines.en: Don't stomp me — a nudge is all I have.

lines.zh: 黏液糊到你手上了。
lines.en: Slime got smeared across your hand.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，然后自己弹开。
lines.en: I ram you, then bounce off by myself.

lines.zh: 这一下大概不疼吧。
lines.en: This probably didn't hurt much at all.

lines.zh: 我咬不动，只能压上去。
lines.en: I can't bite; I just lean on you.

lines.zh: 齿舌刮了一下你的鞋面。
lines.en: My tongue scraped across your shoe.

lines.zh: 我推你，自己反而退了。
lines.en: I push you and slide backward instead.

lines.zh: 我们都在原地没动多少。
lines.en: Neither of us really moved at all.

lines.zh: 我从一片湿叶下探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head from under a wet leaf.

lines.zh: 雨刚停，地上全是我要的。
lines.en: The rain just stopped; the ground is perfect.

lines.zh: 壳上还带着出生时的泥。
lines.en: My shell still carries the mud I was born in.

lines.zh: 这片林地湿润，我就留这。
lines.en: This woodland is damp. I'll stay here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从土缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl slowly out of a crack in the soil.

lines.zh: 周围全是腐叶的味道。
lines.en: The smell of rotting leaves is everywhere.

lines.zh: 阳光太烈，我先缩一下。
lines.en: The sun's too harsh; I'll pull in first.

lines.zh: 这棵倒木下面很适合住。
lines.en: Under this fallen log is a good place.

lines.zh: 我一出生就带着这个壳。
lines.en: I came into the world with this shell.

lines.zh: 我在蘑菇边留下第一条痕。
lines.en: I leave my first trail beside a mushroom.

lines.zh: 林子里安静，正合我意。
lines.en: The woods are quiet, exactly as I like.

lines.zh: 又有一只蜗牛开始赶路了。
lines.en: Another snail has started on its way.

lines.zh: 火苗舔着壳，烫得厉害。
lines.en: Flames lick at my shell, and it burns hot.

lines.zh: 壳先落地，我在里面晕。
lines.en: My shell hit first; I'm dizzy inside it.

lines.zh: 水漫进壳口，我憋住了。
lines.en: Water seeps into my shell; I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，壳上空了一块。
lines.en: A blast, and a piece of shell is gone.

lines.zh: 有箭扎进壳缝里。
lines.en: An arrow stuck in the gap of my shell.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我黏不起来。
lines.en: Violet light and my slime won't stick.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到叶子了。
lines.en: Three days without a single leaf.

lines.zh: 雷落在树顶，我缩进最深。
lines.en: Lightning struck the treetop; I hid deepest.

lines.zh: 壳在往下掉，里面空空的。
lines.en: My shell falls; there's nothing beneath it.
